scope.en: The whole hollow-world skeptics story: three persuasion attempts, the defense force, three random results and both outcomes of the subterranean invasion war (including the former separate 6034/6036 cards).

label.en: If the defenders repel the subterranean invaders
If the invaders take the planet

label.zh: 防御部队之后的随机结果

Outcome of the subterranean war

texts.zh:
即使在会面之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然拒绝接受外星人存在的事实。他们宣称我们并非星际访客，而是穴居人，想要从地上的某个洞穴里面钻出来占领行星的地面。他们的行星，[non_believers_planet.GetName]，被认为是中空的，并且他们坚信我们使用自己的宇宙飞船在中央的空穴中飞来飞去。

这些令人困惑的信仰阻碍了我们的外交工作。任何我们说的或者做的都遭到了彻底的怀疑。
texts.en:
Even after meeting us, the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to accept the existence of extraterrestrial life. They claim we're not interstellar visitors, but subterranean dwellers who climbed to the planet's surface through a hole in the ground. Their planet, [non_believers_planet.GetName], is thought to be hollow, and they believe we fly inside this central cavity using our spaceships.

These baffling beliefs are hindering our diplomatic efforts. Everything we say or do is met with the utmost suspicion.

texts.zh:
即使在会面之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然拒绝接受外星人存在的事实。他们宣称我们并非星际访客，而是穴居人，想要从地上的某个洞穴里面钻出来占领行星的地面。他们的行星，[non_believers_planet.GetName]，被认为是中空的，并且他们坚信我们使用自己的宇宙飞船在中央的空穴中飞来飞去。

这些令人困惑的信仰阻碍了我们的外交工作。任何我们说的或者做的都遭到了彻底的怀疑。。

虽然事实上就是他们错了，但是解释只会让局势变得进一步复杂。
texts.en:
Even after meeting us, the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to accept the existence of extraterrestrial life. They claim we're not interstellar visitors, but subterranean dwellers who climbed to the planet's surface through a hole in the ground. Their planet, [non_believers_planet.GetName], is thought to be hollow, and they believe we fly inside this central cavity using our spaceships.

These baffling beliefs are hindering our diplomatic efforts. Everything we say or do is met with the utmost suspicion..

While technically they're not wrong, explaining the matter would only complicate things further.

label.zh: 将他们最偏激的怀疑论者带到太空。
label.en: Bring their most influential skeptics to space.

label.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]才不是中空的！给他们看计算结果！
label.en: [non_believers_planet.GetName] is not hollow! Show them the calculations!

label.zh: 承认我们就是地底入侵者。
label.en: Admit we are subterranean invaders.

texts.zh:
结果[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不相信太空，或者说：他们认为天空是一块镶嵌着镜子的穹顶，群星是太阳光束折射到镜子上形成的，其他天体同理。

哪怕我们将他们带到了我们的首都，他们可能也会宣称自己从未离开过母星，或者其他同样离谱的事情。
texts.en:
Turns out the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] don't believe in space, either: they think the sky is a glass dome filled with mirrors: stars are rays of sunlight reflected from the mirrors, as are the other celestial bodies.

Even if we were to bring them to our capital, they would probably claim they had never left their home planet, or something equally absurd.

label.en: There must be a way to sway them...

texts.zh: 在下定决心认为我们是中空的[non_believers_planet.GetName]的秘密住民之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始担忧[non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的地表之下到底还藏着什么东西。军队开始在洞穴、喷泉和火山口的附近驻扎，随时准备用武力对抗任何从地下涌现出来的入侵者。
texts.en: After having determined we are the secret inhabitants of Hollow [non_believers_planet.GetName], the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have started worrying about what else may be lurking under the surface of [non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]. Military forces have been stationed near caves, faults and volcanoes, poised to meet any further underground invaders with force.

label.zh: 一起玩呗。给他们提供军事支援。
label.en: Play along. Offer them military support.
This is ludicrous.

texts.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesName]担心穴居人可能会发动一场入侵。这样的担忧是毫无根据的，但是提供额外的部队能够帮助我们赢取他们的信任。
texts.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesName] are worried about a possible subterranean invasion. It's a baseless fear, but providing additional troops will help us gain their trust.

texts.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]传来难以置信的消息：真的有人藏在地表之下。属于某个先前未知物种的地下军队从洞穴里面涌现了出来，他们正在进攻[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这是一场全面的入侵！
texts.en: Incredible news from [non_believers_planet.GetName]: someone really was hiding under the surface! Subterranean armies of a previously unknown species are pouring out of caves, and they're attacking the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It's a full-scale invasion!

label.en: This feels familiar...
This feels familiar...
Disconcerting.

label.zh: 若守军击退地底入侵者
label.en: If the defenders repel the subterranean invaders
If the invaders take the planet

texts.zh: 经过一场漫长的、难解难分的战斗，[non_believers_country.GetName]迫使地底入侵者撤退回到了[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地表之下！
texts.en: After a long, hard-fought battle, the [non_believers_country.GetName] forced the subterranean invaders to retreat under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface!

texts.zh: 经过一场漫长的、难解难分的战斗，我们的联合部队战胜了地底入侵者，将他们赶回了[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地表之下！
texts.en: After a long, hard-fought battle, our combined forces triumphed over the subterranean invaders, forcing them back under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface!

label.en: Excellent.

texts.zh: 在经历了一场残酷的世界大战之后，[non_believers_country.GetName]被住在[non_believers_planet.GetName]地表下面的穴居物种彻底消灭。新近成为主导的物种注意到了我们的存在，出于某种混乱的好运，他们显然没有认为我们是来自他们行星的中心。
texts.en: After a vicious world war, the [non_believers_country.GetName] has been annihilated by the subterranean race living under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface. The newly dominant species is aware of our presence, and in something of a mixed blessing, obviously does not believe we come from the center of their planet.

label.zh: 终于，新邻居能够讲道理了。
label.en: Finally, reasonable neighbors.
The old civilization falls

note.zh: 新的地底前超光速文明取而代之。
note.en: A new subterranean pre-FTL civilization replaces it.

texts.zh: 某个表面看上去已经死寂的火山突然喷发，正在摧毁一切，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]绝望地寻求帮助。
texts.en: The sudden eruption of a seemingly extinct volcano was devastating, and the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are desperate for help.

texts.zh: 某个表面看上去已经死寂的火山突然喷发，摧毁了这个区域的基础设施。然而，幸亏我们的军队就出现在事发点附近，大多数受灾群众都被安全地撤离。
texts.en: The sudden eruption of a seemingly extinct volcano was devastating to the region's infrastructure. However, thanks to our military presence near the scene, most of the affected population was evacuated safely.

label.zh: 至少他们现在信任我们了。
label.en: At least they trust us now.

texts.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]希望向我们表达感谢，以及正式的道歉。他们现在明白我们，事实上，并不是地底穴居人，而是来自另一个地方，那里是：
texts.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would like to offer us their thanks, as well as an official apology. They now understand we are not, in fact, subterranean dwellers, but we come from another place entirely:

texts.zh: 他们对于宇宙奥妙的掌握还是不够完美，但至少他们准备相信我们了。
texts.en: Their grasp of cosmology is still less than perfect, but at least now they are ready to trust us.

label.zh: 从社会学角度来看，很有趣；从精神上来看，真是精疲力竭的体验。
label.en: A sociologically interesting but mentally exhausting experience.
They finally trust us

note.zh: 移除他们的不信任修正。

texts.zh: 地底入侵防御部队的士兵驻扎在最大的洞穴和火山口旁边，他们报告称完全没有任何东西从地表下面冒出来。或许这是最好的情况，但是其中一些士兵明显十分失望。
texts.en: The Subterranean Invasion Defense Force troops stationed near the biggest caves and volcanoes report that absolutely nothing has emerged from beneath the surface. It's probably for the best, although some of the soldiers look visibly disappointed.

label.en: Acknowledged.

texts.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]传来纷乱的新闻：尽管[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不再认为我们是来自他们[non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地底中心的访客，他们现在坚信自己的星球是平的，像我们这样的人是住在吊篮一样的城市里，位于[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地壳下面。
texts.en: Mixed news from [non_believers_planet.GetName]: while the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] don't think we are visitors from the center of their [non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon] anymore, they are now convinced their world is flat, and people like us live on hanging cities beneath [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s crust.

label.en: There must be a way to sway them...

texts.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]出于我们的诚实向我们表达感谢。当然他们尚未完全相信我们，因为他们认为我们是来自中空的[non_believers_planet.GetName]的入侵者，但是至少他们理解我们没有敌意，希望他们能同我们开展合作。
texts.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] thank us for our honesty. Of course they can't fully trust us yet, since they still believe we are invaders from the Hollow [non_believers_planet.GetName], but at least they understand we wish them no harm and are looking forward to collaborating with us.

label.en: There must be a way to sway them...

# 那里有生命存在吗？ / Is There Life In There?

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12
- 来源 Sources：`events/first_contact_dlc_events.txt:7595-8171`；`common/special_projects/00_projects_first_contact_dlc.txt:353-410`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:468, 538-560`（on_five_year_random_pulse_pre_ftl）；`events/on_action_events_2.txt:3146-3179`（action.620/621）

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 每五年的国家检查运行 action.620：拥有“首次接触”DLC、且与某个前超光速文明有生效协议的普通帝国，会在 0–360 天后抽取“前超光速外交事件池”（无事 200，本事件 10，条件不满足的事件被跳过）。
  The five-year country pulse runs action.620: a regular empire with the First Contact DLC and an active agreement with a pre-FTL civilization draws from the pre-FTL diplomacy pool 0-360 days later (nothing 200, this event 10; events whose conditions fail are skipped).
- 条件：境内有被观测的前超光速文明，且它不是地底文明、没有“地平说”国民理念、也不是本国“挣脱桎梏”的母族；全银河只发生一次。
  Conditions: an observed pre-FTL civilization within our borders that is not subterranean, lacks the Flat World Theory civic and is not our Broken Shackles parent; once per galaxy.
- 发生后设置“近期前超光速外交事件”冷却，其他此类事件暂不出现。
  Afterwards a "recent pre-FTL diplomatic event" cooldown blocks the other events of this pool for a while.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 6000「那里有生命存在吗？」：他们拒绝相信外星生命，认为我们是从空心星球内部钻出来的地底居民。
  6000 "Is There Life In There?": they refuse to believe in aliens and think we are dwellers from inside their hollow planet.
- 三种尝试（15–30 天后）：带怀疑论者上太空 → 6005（他们认为天空是镜子穹顶）；展示计算 → 6015（他们转而认为世界是平的）；承认是地底入侵者 → 6020（他们感谢我们的坦诚）。三者都在 30–60 天后进入 6025「地底入侵防御部队」。
  Three attempts (15-30 days later): take skeptics to space → 6005 (they think the sky is a mirrored dome); show the calculations → 6015 (now they think the world is flat); admit we are subterranean invaders → 6020 (they thank us for our honesty). All lead 30-60 days later to 6025 "Subterranean Invasion Defense Force".
- 6025：配合演出，派运输舰执行 80 天项目（期限 1080 天）支援防御；或“荒唐”→ 360–1080 天后随机结果。项目完成（或超时失败）同样随机：20% 6030「突然袭击！」、30% 6032「突然爆发！」、50% 6033「异常气候」（不选项目时为 35/35/30）。
  6025: play along and send a transport on an 80-day project (1080-day limit) to support their defenses; or "this is ludicrous" → a random result 360-1080 days later. Finishing (or failing) the project rolls the same way: 20% 6030 "Sudden Attack!", 30% 6032 "Sudden Eruption!", 50% 6033 "Anticlimactic" (35/35/30 without the project).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 6032 与 6033 在 15 天后接 6035「观点的变动」：他们道歉，但仍对宇宙学一知半解（认为我们来自海洋、恒星中心等）。
  6032 and 6033 lead 15 days later to 6035 "A Change Of Perspective": they apologize, still misunderstanding cosmology (we come from the ocean, the center of their star, ...).
- 6030：真有地底文明涌出，发动全面入侵（生成地底国家与 3 支军队）。若守军获胜（on_colony_defenders_win → 隐藏 6034）→ 6038「滚回地下！」→ 15 天后 6035；若守军失败（on_colony_defenders_lose → 隐藏 6036）→ 6037「曾为天人，今为尘土」：原文明被消灭，星球上生成新的地底前超光速文明并已知晓我们。
  6030: a real subterranean civilization pours out and invades (a subterranean nation with 3 armies). If the defenders win (on_colony_defenders_win → hidden 6034) → 6038 "Go Back Underground!" → 15 days later 6035; if they lose (on_colony_defenders_lose → hidden 6036) → 6037 "As Above, So Below": the old civilization is annihilated and a new subterranean pre-FTL civilization, aware of us, takes the planet.
- 三种随机结果互斥；入侵战争的胜负互斥。
  The three random results are exclusive; the invasion war has exclusive win/lose outcomes.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 6032 若我们派过防御部队（项目完成）则正文改为“多数人员被安全撤离”。6000 有两种正文。
  6032 uses a "most were evacuated" text if our defense force was sent (project completed). 6000 has two text versions.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：6000–6038 全部事件、项目定义（80天、期限1080、成功/失败权重）、守军胜负回调与延迟。
  Checked: all events 6000-6038, the project (80 days, 1080 limit, success/failure weights), the defender win/lose callbacks and delays.
- 更正：原“滚回地下！”（6034）与“曾为天人，今为尘土”（6036）为独立卡片，实为 6030 入侵战争的两种结局，已并入并接在 6030 之后。
  Correction: "Go Back Underground!" (6034) and "As Above, So Below" (6036) were separate cards; they are the two outcomes of 6030's invasion war and now follow 6030.
